title: Islanded-tenant rollback conductor and cross-environment customer escalation pathway
creator: Priya Kapoor
description:
Summary: This ticket captures an operational playbook and a coordinating orchestration change for handling 'islanded' tenant regressions observed during mixed-hosting model rollouts (Hosted, Dedicated, Private). The goal is to provide a deterministic path for: 1) rapid detection and tenant isolation, 2) coordinated rollback or live-patch across environments, 3) KV-cache and prefix-caching reconciliation, and 4) a customer communication and remediation workflow that minimizes false positives and avoids cross-tenant state leakage.

Scope: The document covers alert thresholds, triage roles (Incident Commander, Serving Lead, CS Liaison), automated orchestration primitives (slice quaratine, traffic pinning, variant fallback), operational commands for cache reconciliation and rehydration, PR and patch pathways for quick fixes, and runbook text for handoffs to Dedicated/Private deployment teams. Not in scope: long-term model re-training or policy decisions about model decommissioning (those belong to Model Ops).

Why now: Over the last quarter we had two regressions where a canary variant produced sticky artifacts that affected a subset of Dedicated tenants and leaked into Hosted through shared routing fallbacks. That exposure increased time-to-remediate and required manual reconciliation of KV caches. This work reduces mean time to customer mitigation, standardizes comms, and reduces blast radius during rollbacks.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook text reviewed and signed off by Serving, Runtime, and CS leads
Orchestration primitives implemented: slice-quarantine, tenant-pin, staged-fallback policy
Automated kvcache-evict and rehydrate command documented with verification steps
One cross-environment drill completed with <30 min containment time in simulated regression
notes: Decision: prefer staged tenant-pin + variant-fallback over immediate global rollback to preserve non-impacted tenants' availability (agreed 2026-02-22)
Trade-off: tenant-pin increases short-term latency for pinned tenants due to smaller pool; acceptable for P0 containment vs broad rollback risk
Implementation will add a lightweight orchestration flag (slice_quarantine=true) to the routing control plane and a one-shot kvcache-evict endpoint behind auth

runbook_steps: 1) Alert: Canary-quality-drop > 15% for 3 mins or sustained false-positive rate above threshold triggers an 'islanded-tenant' investigation
2) Triage: Incident Commander assigns Serving Lead + CS Liaison and marks customer-impact high
3) Quarantine: Apply slice_quarantine to affected tenant slice to prevent cross-tenant fallback
4) Pin traffic: tenant-pin traffic to a variant known-good model or earlier pinned version
5) Verify: run live-sample prompt set against pinned variant and check scores on quality dashboard
6) If pinned variant passes: initiate a staged rollout to non-impacted slices; if not: open hotpatch PR and coordinate live-patch
7) KV Cache Reconciliation: run kvcache-evict for affected slice, then rehydrate via controlled replay (documented command and verification hash)
8) Communication: CS Liaison notifies customer via templated message; status updates every 30 min until resolved
9) Postmortem: Create incident writeup, update eval prompt set and gating for future canaries
playbook_examples: Quick rollback: apply tenant-pin to fall back to model-v1.18, then schedule global rollout freeze
Live-patch path: apply small param patch (PR #1237) to model variant, run smoke eval against tenant prompts, then unquarantine slice
Cache-staleness mitigation: evict kvcache + force prefix-cache rehydrate with synthetic prefix traffic; verify using checksum comparison
